## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v`
- [ ] Documentation checks pass: `docsprout check` and `docsprout audit --strict`
- [ ] Guides, examples or migration notes updated when behaviour changes
- [ ] For a release: version metadata, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/versions.json` and workflow pins updated together
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or credentials added
